verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an LLM-oriented markdown output (output=md, the /search.md endpoint, or an Accept: text/markdown header). It is described as curated for LLMs and roughly half the tokens of JSON, works with every API, and a fields parameter can trim payload size. SerpApi also explicitly markets search data as RAG grounding. Ranking, however, is simply the scraped search-engine order: there is no relevance scoring, chunking, token-budget control or page-content extraction for LLM context. missing for 10: LLM-relevance ranking or scoring, token-budget or chunk-size controls, full-page content extraction, independent hands-on corroboration of the markdown output's RAG suitability.
